Following the [tutorial](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/amt/vignettes/p4_SSF.html) by Johannes Signer.

```{r}
# -----loading packages-----
# general use
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)

# spatial
library(terra)
#library(tidyterra)
library(amt) # ssf
library(survival)

```

```{r}
# -----loading data-----
ele_data <- read_csv(here("data", "elephant_2010-Feb2020.csv"))
```

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 1: Getting the data ready
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```{r}
# cleaning data
ele_clean <- ele_data |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(dt = mdy_hm(dt))

# structure tracking data
ele_trk <- make_track(ele_clean,
                      .x = lon, .y = lat, .t = dt,
                      id = id, crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
summarize_sampling_rate(ele_trk)
```

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 2: Prepare data for SSF
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
ele_trk_reg <- ele_trk |> 
  # nest all data except for id
  nest(data = -id) |> 
  # for every xyt in data, resample and create steps by burst, and store in 'steps' column
  mutate(steps = map(data, function(x) {
    x |>
      track_resample(rate = hours(1), tolerance = minutes(15)) |>
      steps_by_burst()
  })) |>
  # select id and steps column
  select(id, steps) |> 
  # unnest everything in steps column
  unnest(cols = steps)

# create random/control steps
ele_trk_reg <- ele_trk_reg |> 
  random_steps(10)
```

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 3: Prepare raster stack for environmental covariates
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
file_paths <- c()
anthro_folder <- here("data", "ssf_anthro_data")
enviro_folder <- here("data", "ssf_enviro_data")
ssf_data <- c(anthro_folder, enviro_folder)

# create a vector of file paths to each raster
for (folder in ssf_data) {
  for (file in list.files(folder)){
    file_paths <- c(file_paths, here(folder, file))
  }
}

crop_extent <- ext(18.461667,  25.283338, -20.916664, -17.133330)
target_res <- 0.008333333
template <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

raster_list <- c()

# create raster stack
raster_list <- map(file_paths, function(fp) {
  r <- rast(fp)                                                                 # turn file path into raster
  r <- r[[nlyr(r)]]                                                             # only include the last layer
  project(r, template, method = "bilinear")                                     # project
})

raster_stack <- rast(raster_list)                                               # create stack from list
names(raster_stack) <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_paths))                 
```


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 4: Fitting SSF
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
# Preliminary step: extract covariates to points
ele_trk_extracted <- ele_trk_reg |> 
  extract_covariates(raster_stack)

ele_trk_extracted <- ele_trk_extracted |> clean_names()
```

```{r}
m0 <- clogit(case ~ cci_built_img_1 + cci_cropland_img + copy_of_roads_distance_rast + dist_to_fences + nam_pd_2020_1km + cci_grassland_img + cci_shrub_img + cci_tree_img + cci_water_img + copy_of_core_dist_rast + rivers_dist_rast + slope + strata(step_id),
             data = ele_trk_extracted)
```
